summary: Frontend regression test for Loader2 fix + full end-to-end proof that product categories are FULLY DYNAMIC (single source of truth = /api/categories). All 4 requested scenarios PASSED with zero JS/React runtime errors on all tested admin & customer pages.
action_items: Optional: In /app/frontend/src/pages/customer/Home.jsx, the CATEGORY_IMAGES fallback map only has 6 well-known category names. New categories (e.g. 'ZZ-Testing-Dynamic-Cat') fall back to CATEGORY_IMAGES.Baju (a t-shirt photo). Not a bug (per problem statement), but consider requiring an `image` upload/URL on category create, or shipping a truly generic placeholder as the ultimate fallback so a new category tile doesn't visually inherit the 'Baju' image.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminProductForm.jsx no longer has undefined-symbol issues after the fix; import list is clean and correct (Loader2, getFileUrl both present at lines 3-4).

Home.jsx / Products.jsx / AdminProductForm.jsx and AdminCategories.jsx all consume `api.get('/categories')` — verified: NO hardcoded category list anywhere. The CATEGORY_IMAGES map on Home is a visual-fallback map only; the render loop iterates over `categories` state from the API, never over that map.

AdminCategories.jsx currently uses window.confirm() before delete — a native browser confirm popup instead of a themed shadcn AlertDialog. Cosmetic (works fine in tests via dialog handler), but a UX improvement candidate.
test_credentials: Admin was RESET at test start (deleted /admin/root user, restarted backend so seed_startup recreated admin/1234 with first_setup_done=false). During test, first-setup created NEW admin: username=testadmin / password=secret6 / email=t@test.com / phone=628. At end of test, admin state = testadmin/secret6 (first_setup_done=true). admin/1234 is now DISABLED again. Next test run should either (a) use testadmin/secret6 or (b) reset admin via same procedure.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All ZZ-prefixed test data (ZZ-Testing-Dynamic-Cat → renamed to ZZ-Renamed → deleted) was cleaned up as part of the test. Additionally, a backend-only ZZ-Temp-For-Delete-Test category + TEST_TempProd product were created to verify the 400-on-linked-delete safety check, then both deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live admin credentials at end of this iteration: testadmin / secret6. admin/1234 disabled. To reset for a fresh first-setup run: delete users where role='admin' from Mongo and restart backend (sudo supervisorctl restart backend). Category CRUD + safety check verified via /api/categories. DB state is clean; 6 default categories only. login_attempts collection was cleared at start of run.
